t: This is 79 Pall Mall, a Grade II listed building. It was designed by the Scottish architect David Brandon for the Eagle Insurance Company, and built between 1866 and 1868. Brandon worked mostly in the Gothic style, in partnership with Thomas Wyatt. Look for the blue plaque. It marks the fact that a brick townhouse once stood on this site, and that Nell Gwynne lived there after she retired from the stage. So the current building replaced the home of one of London's best-known actresses.
